scope: User-frozen10 native configurations for Day10 preparation; no new batch enabled
lip_semantics: target landmark vertical mouth opening / horizontal mouth width, not probability
pose_semantics: absolute motion-model yaw in degrees; positive=image left, negative=image right; achieved pose not guaranteed
pose_range_note: Official UI uses relative yaw within +/-25. Absolute35/45 are explicitly experimental matrix extrapolations, not author-validated limits.
freeze_basis: User explicitly froze Day9 controls on2026-10-28; no new inference or quality certification
semantic_text_role: English descriptions are immutable metadata, not native language conditioning

scheduling.source_policy: minimum prior uses among eligible unique-SHA sources; stable SHA ties; optional hard per-source cap; no replacement after rejection

known_risks: E033 left-turn L1/L2/L3: visible face near image edge, possible clipping and HOG misses;3 historical Gate1 rejections retained
Absolute35/45-degree targets exceed the official UI relative-yaw range; quality remains pending human review
